name: plaud-app-ui
description: Component-mode frontend for aw-app-plaud — the Apps › Plaud window body (core.window.body:plaud.main): connection status, recordings list, audio player, download, transcript and summary. src/plugin.jsx is the integrated-mode entry (register(host)), built as a Vite lib-mode bundle consumed by aw-app.json's contributes.frontend.bundle.
